svg.title: Recurrence rate by file class, 552 file-sessions
svg.desc: Share of edited files that showed renewed struggle within the next three sessions, by file class, on 552 file-sessions with 39 outcomes. Code: 34 outcomes of 285 file-sessions, a rate of 0.119. Docs: 1 of 192, a rate of 0.005. Config: 0 of 37, a rate of zero. Notes and web are omitted as too thin to read at 19 and 7 file-sessions.
svg.text: does churn in this kind of file mean anything?
share of edited files that struggled again within 3 sessions · 552 file-sessions, 39 outcomes
notes (19) and web (7) are left out: too few file-sessions to read as a rate.
single author, one machine. descriptive, not a causal claim.
